newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wuhua to list A shares in Shenzhen Dec 5.
newsitem.headline: Wuhua to list A shares in Shenzhen Dec 5.

text.p: Conglomerate Kunming Wuhua Industry (Group) Co Ltd said on Tuesday it would list 22.71 million A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange on December 5.
The shares last traded on the unofficial grey market at eight to nine yuan, but broking industry sources expected them to be quoted at about 15 yuan when they initially list.

The company, in a statement published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times, said net profit in the first nine months of 1996 was 32.26 million yuan. It forecast after-tax profit of 47.01 million yuan for the full calendar year. In 1995, net profit was 39.0 9 million yuan, down from 48.33 million in 1994.

Kunming, a retailer that has diversified into tourism, real-estate, transport and storage, first applied to list shares on the Shenzhen bourse in 1990, but has only just received approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission.
Group share capital totals 87.51 million shares, consisting of 64.80 million owned by state companies and 22.71 million A shares, it said.
Wuhua's listing is sponsored by Shanghai's Shenyin & Wanguo Securities Co Ltd and J&A Securities Co Ltd of Shenzhen.
